monument.purpose: The name set whole across the hero foot and again in the footer, drawn as filament (FilamentText SVG: wire, stuttering glow, fill); follows ?brand=.

display.purpose: The featured piece's name in its scene («Мста»), the product sheet's name; scroll beats and figures.

headline.purpose: Chapter headings, process step lines, scene and sheet prices, the sent-request title, the made-by heading, the 404 line.

statement.purpose: One-sentence declarations: hero close, dacha overlay; the manifesto at its own larger clamp.

title.purpose: Spec values, vitrine lamp names and counter, contacts, footer places, process counters, header wordmark.

action.purpose: Text-link calls to action; buttons use Onest 500 at body size; header call, nav, dimmer, language switch and chips at label size.

label.purpose: Field labels, captions, term labels, legal, the menu toggle; sentence case.

shadows.name: pane-hairline
shadows.purpose: The warm edge of every flat pane, the header bar, the map card and the try-on bar; a border, not elevation.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus only (src/polish.css); round on pills.

shadows.name: input-focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Input focus ring on the dark form.

shadows.name: bulb-glow
shadows.purpose: A lit bulb on the process wire: drawn light, not elevation.

shadows.name: chandelier-scrim
shadows.purpose: The one darkening gradient on footage: under the chandelier's text, off on phones.

shadows.name: veil
shadows.value: fixed #000 layer, opacity up to 0.45 at section seams
shadows.purpose: Soft dimming between reading sections (useVeil in App.jsx); skipped with reduced motion.

shadows.name: drawn-light
shadows.value: StarBorder, FilamentText, logo filament, DappledLight, process wire and bulbs, map halos, candela curve, try-on glow, dark-room torch, LightRays, SideRays, 404 light pool
shadows.purpose: Light in its named places, in filament and 2700 K. WebGL ones (LightRays, SideRays, DappledLight) mount only through Lazy.jsx.

motion.name: lux
motion.purpose: Type and lines: masked word rise (1.1s, 0.05s stagger), letter roll (520ms, 16ms stagger), CTA line draw-back (700ms), header bar settle (700ms), sheet words (0.9s). GSAP CustomEase 'lux', CSS --ease-lux.

motion.name: silk
motion.purpose: Pictures, pills and flights: product-sheet FLIP flight (0.95s), nav pill slide (0.6s), vitrine frame grow (900ms), process photo open (700ms), switch knob slide (420ms), press scale. GSAP CustomEase 'silk', CSS --ease-out.

motion.name: surface-lines
motion.value: power1.out 1.8s, opacity 0.12 to 1, 0.1s stagger; block y 50px power2.out 2s

motion.name: filament-draw
motion.value: wire strokeDashoffset 1.5s power2.inOut, 0.09s stagger; halo stutter from 0.55s; fill 1.1s power2.out from 1.35s
motion.purpose: FilamentText: the hero name (after the loader), footer name and 404 number (in view).

motion.name: catch
motion.purpose: A lamp coming on: vitrine lit photo, process bulbs, map halos.

motion.name: veil
motion.value: opacity 0.45 * smoothstep over 28% of the viewport around each seam
motion.purpose: Dimming between rooms, one fixed layer moved by opacity alone.

motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.purpose: Wheel smoothing on fine pointers; off for touch and reduced motion.

motion.name: light-effects
motion.value: StarBorder comet 5s loop; LightRays speed 0.6; SideRays speed 1.2; DappledLight shader at half resolution
motion.purpose: Continuous motion of drawn light; WebGL skipped with reduced motion (Lazy never mounts).

motion.name: media-playback
motion.value: playWhileOnScreen (src/lib/media.js): one video at a time, off-screen videos release their decoder
motion.purpose: Every video goes through it; Chrome drops the page to 30 Hz for good if two videos ever play together. The hero lamp film (all-intra lamp-1920.mp4 / lamp-m.mp4) is a scroll scrub registered with play: false.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Dark Room, Switched On"**

The page is a dark room and the visitor's scroll is the hand on the switch. Everything rests on soot black, from the first screen to the footer, the request form and the menu included; light arrives through footage, photographs, one warm filament colour that marks what is lit (the name, the lamp names, the prices, the readouts, whatever is switched on) and drawn light placed where a lamp would throw it. Chapters are told apart by the chapter gap, the cinematic black of the scenes, the dusk-green ground of the dacha and the night ground of the map, and by one veil of black that dims softly as each seam between rooms crosses the middle of the screen.

Type works at two extremes. Oranienbaum, a narrow, sharp Cyrillic display serif, sets the name as a monument across the full width and every heading at large scale; Onest carries everything that is read or pressed. The name itself is drawn as filament: a glowing wire traces each letter, the glow stutters as the coil catches, then the letters fill with warm light. Surfaces are flat fills with soft corners (the owner rejects square buttons): pill controls and flat panes (soot at 88% with a 1px warm hairline) laid over the films and photographs. There is no glass and no backdrop blur: nothing behind a panel is re-filtered while the page scrolls.

The visitor can hold the light themselves. A dimmer in the header sets the colour temperature of the whole page (1800 to 4000 K, a multiply layer, off at 2700 K); the dark room switches four sources on its photograph; the product sheet re-tints its photograph in three shades and lets the lamp be tried on a photo of the visitor's own room. The page speaks Russian or English and can wear the name of the company it was sent to (`?brand=`): the hero, header, footer, tab title and the mark's filament initial all follow.

Motion is the system's second material. Two curves govern it, and each kind of content arrives its own way, once: words tip up out of a masked line, running text surfaces line by line, labels roll letter by letter, the name draws as filament, lamps catch with a flicker. Scrubbed and held scenes (the switch-on room, the chandelier, the vitrine row and the process wire on desktop, the dusk film) are pinned to scroll.
keyCharacteristics: Soot-black ground on every chapter (dusk for the dacha, night for the map); light carried by footage, the filament colour and drawn light in its named places.
Oranienbaum at monument scale against Onest text; two weights of Onest only (400, 500).
Chapters told apart by the chapter gap, cinematic black, the dusk and night fields and the veil that dims at each seam.
Pill controls and flat 20 to 28px panes with a warm hairline; no glass, no backdrop blur.
Calls to action in the story are words with a drawn line and an arrow; filled controls are reserved for switches, selections and sending.
The visitor holds the light: a page-wide Kelvin dimmer, switchable sources in the dark room, tints and try-on in the product sheet.
One arrival per kind of content, on the lux and silk curves.

rules.name: The Lit Thing Rule
rules.body: Filament marks what is lit: the name, lamp names, prices, readouts, calls to action, lit points and whatever the visitor has switched on (as a 12 to 18% tint, or solid on a chosen colour temperature). It is never a resting background; as a line it appears only as the 10 to 12% hairline at the edge of panes, the header bar, the map card, the try-on bar and the form frame.

rules.name: The Touch Rule
rules.body: 2700 K fills only something the visitor switches, selects or sends, including adding to and opening the request. If it does not change state or submit, it does not get an orange fill; inside drawn light 2700 K is light, not fill.

rules.name: The Rooms Not Boxes Rule
rules.body: Sections are separated by the chapter gap, the black of the cinematic scenes, the dusk and night fields and the veil, never by rules or dividers between sections. Hairlines between rows inside a list (map places, trade terms, files, estimate rows) are part of the list, not the page.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Oranienbaum speaks (names, headings, figures, statements); Onest explains and acts. No third face, no italics, no uppercase labels. Names that are capitals by nature (the language codes RU/EN, the map's МКАД and ТТК) are names, not labels.

rules.name: The Monument Rule
rules.body: The name is set whole, at full width, once at the top and once at the end, always drawn as filament. It is never cropped, wrapped or used as a texture; a longer `?brand=` name is set smaller so it still spans the screen.

rules.name: The Whole Glyph Rule
rules.body: Display type is set tight, so every GSAP SplitText call passes `charsClass`, `wordsClass` and `linesClass`. SplitText names its masks after those classes, and only then do the `.char-mask`, `.word-mask` and `.line-mask` paddings in styles.css (with equal negative margins) reach the masks and keep descenders, the bowl of «ь» and overshoots from being clipped. Masks inside headings and the hero title take `pointer-events: none`, because their padding reaches tens of pixels past a monument letter and once covered the hero switch.

rules.name: The Drawn Light Rule
rules.body: By the owner's request, glows, gradients, rays and animated lines are allowed, but only as light in its places: the StarBorder comet round the header call, the FilamentText name (hero, footer, 404) and the logo's filament initial, the dappled sun through leaves behind the dacha heading, the bulbs and wire of the process, the halos of lit projects on the map, the candela curve in the trade section, the glow round a lamp tried on in the product sheet, the torch under the pointer in the dark room, the LightRays cone over the request, the SideRays in the footer and the faint pool of light on the 404. They draw in filament and 2700 K (the process wire and the dimmer's track also reach #ff8a3d, and the dimmer's track runs to cool white because it is the colour-temperature scale itself), they never carry content, and the surfaces around them stay flat.

rules.name: The Single Scrim Rule
rules.body: Outside drawn light, a gradient is allowed only as a neutral darkening under text on footage, or as an alpha mask that lets a film or a row fade into the dark (the manifesto bulb, the vitrine's edges, the dappled light), never as colour or decoration.

dos: **Do** keep every ground flat soot (dusk for the dacha, night for the map, black for footage), with footage and drawn light supplying the light.
**Do** set the name, lamp names, prices, readouts and whatever is switched on in filament, and nothing structural.
**Do** ask with words in the story: a text link with a 2px line and an arrow, in filament.
**Do** reserve filled pills for switches, selections and the request; fill 2700 K only on what the visitor switches, selects or sends.
**Do** put panels on the flat `Pane`: soot at 88% with the 12% filament hairline.
**Do** draw the name with FilamentText and let it follow `?brand=`.
**Do** write every string as `t(ru, en)` and every price through `money()`.
**Do** mount every WebGL scene through `Lazy.jsx` and play every video through `playWhileOnScreen`.
**Do** pass `charsClass`, `wordsClass` and `linesClass` to every SplitText call, and keep masks inside headings at `pointer-events: none`.
**Do** use the lux curve (0.35, 0, 0, 1) for type and lines and the silk curve (0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for pictures, pills and flights.
**Do** give each kind of content its one arrival, once per element.
**Do** show keyboard focus as the warm ring and halo, and give every control a 44px target on coarse pointers.
donts: **Don't** add drop shadows, text shadows or coloured gradient washes to surfaces; outside drawn light the only gradient is the neutral scrim under text on the chandelier film or an alpha fade into the dark.
**Don't** bring back glass or backdrop blur; panels are flat.
**Don't** add drawn light outside its named places, or draw it in colours other than filament and 2700 K.
**Don't** let two videos play at once, or mount a WebGL scene outside `Lazy.jsx`.
**Don't** bring back a light plaster ground; the page, the form, the sheet and the menu are dark.
**Don't** draw borders, hairlines or dividers between sections.
**Don't** use square buttons or square chips; controls are pills.
**Don't** use filament or 2700 K as a resting background field or for body text.
**Don't** add a third typeface, italics, or uppercase tracked labels.
**Don't** fill a call to action that is not a switch, a selection or part of the request; the header call is a soot pill lit by its comet, the trade call a filament tint.
